pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.2: tena kho pana samayena āyasmā upanando sakyaputto sahāyassa gharaṃ gantvā tassa pajāpatiyā saddhiṃ sayanighare nisajjaṃ kappesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.3: atha kho so puriso yenāyasmā upanando sakyaputto tenupasaṅkami. upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.4: ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so puriso pajāpatiṃ etadavoca. “dehayyassa bhikkha”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.5: atha kho sā itthi āyasmato upanandassa sakyaputtassa bhikkhaṃ adāsi
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.6: atha kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ satyaputtaṃ etadavoca: “gacchatha bhante yato ayyassa bhikkhā dinnā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.7: atha kho sā itthī sallakkhetvā pariyuṭṭhito ayaṃ purisoti āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ etadavoca. “nisīdatha bhante mā agamitthā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.9: tatiyampi kho so puriso āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ etadavoca: “gacchatha bhante yato ayyassa bhikkhā dinnā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.10: tatiyampi kho sā itthi āyasmantaṃ upanandaṃ sakyaputtaṃ etadavoca: “nisīdatha bhante mā agamitthā”ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.11: atha kho so puriso nikkhamitvā bhikkhū ujjhāpesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.12: “ayaṃ bhante ayyo upanando mayhaṃ pajāpatiyā saddhiṃ sayanighare nisinno
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.13: so mayā uyyojiyamāno na icchati. gantuṃ
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.15: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.16: “kathaṃ hi nāma āyasmā upanando sakyaputto sabhojane kule anupakhajja nisajjaṃ kappessatī”ti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.17: saccaṃ kira tvaṃ upananda sabhojane kule anupakhajja nisajjaṃ kappesīti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.20: kathaṃ hi nāma tvaṃ moghapurisa sabhojane kule anupakhajja nisajjaṃ kappessasi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.22: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:1.23.1: “yo pana bhikkhu sabhojane kule anupakhajja nisajjaṃ kappeyya pācittiya”nti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc43:2.1.6: itthi ceva hoti puriso ca itthi ca puriso ca ubho anikkhantā honti ubho avītarāgā.
